properties.name: --dz-dropzone-bg-active
properties.description: Drop-target background while dragging over — chains --base-drop-target-bg-active (success 15% light / 30% dark)

properties.name: --dz-dropzone-bg-armed
properties.description: Armed drop-target background while files are dragged anywhere over the page (highlight-on-page-drag) — chains --base-drop-target-bg (success 10% light / 20% dark)

properties.name: --dz-dropzone-border-active
properties.description: Drop-target border while dragging over — 2px solid --base-drop-target-border-color (success)

properties.name: --dz-dropzone-card-big-text-font-size
properties.description: dropzone card big text font size

properties.name: --dz-dropzone-card-minimal-text-font-size
properties.description: dropzone card minimal text font size

properties.name: --dz-file-list-max-height
properties.description: inline file-list max height; unset = none (grows with content). Input variable: not declared on :host, read as var(--dz-file-list-max-height, none) so a value on <web-dropzone> reaches the satellite list

properties.name: --dz-font-family
properties.description: component font family (overrides --base-font-family). Input variable: read as var(--dz-font-family, var(--base-font-family, inherit))

properties.name: --dz-main-bg
properties.description: main bg — the contract input surfaces, text levels and borders derive from

properties.name: --dz-preview-item-object-fit
properties.description: how the thumbnail fills its tile in the uniform grid (cover | contain; forced to contain in grid-layout="natural")

properties.name: --dz-preview-item-size
properties.description: in-card grid tile width + height (files-inside); auto = sized to content

properties.name: --dz-preview-row-height
properties.description: row height for grid-layout="natural" (tile widths follow each image ratio)

properties.name: --dz-preview-status-overlay-bg
properties.description: veil over a finished thumbnail in grid-status="overlay"

properties.name: --dz-preview-status-overlay-icon-size
properties.description: centred status glyph size in grid-status="overlay"

properties.name: --dz-rem
properties.description: base sizing unit for proportional scaling (default 10px). Input variable: not declared on :host, read as var(--dz-rem, 10px) so a value on <web-dropzone> or any ancestor reaches every satellite

properties.name: --dz-shadow-color
properties.description: shadow color — popover, drag indicator, overlay hover

properties.name: --dz-loader-icon
properties.description: loader shape, a mask image in currentColor (base: --base-loader-icon)

properties.name: --dz-loader-rotate
properties.description: loader rotation per cycle, 1turn; 0 = the SVG animates itself (base: --base-loader-rotate)

properties.name: --dz-touch-target-min
properties.description: minimum tap size of phone-mode controls — the close button of the full-screen sheet (indicator drawer, compact popover), 44px (base: --base-touch-target-min)

properties.name: --dz-uploading-pulse-duration
properties.description: uploading-row pulse loop (1.5s; 0s under reduced motion)
